prompt: E2E demo: ask the user which deployment target to use before proceeding.

questions.question: Which deployment target should I use for this release?

options.label: Staging
options.description: Deploy to the staging environment for validation before a production rollout.
options.preview:
## Staging deploy plan

- Build the `staging` bundle
- Run smoke tests against the staging API
- Notify #eng-staging on completion

options.label: Production
options.description: Deploy directly to production. Skips the staging validation step.
options.preview:
## Production deploy plan

- Build the `production` bundle
- Run the full release checklist
- Page on-call if the deploy fails

options.label: Canary
options.description: Roll out to 5% of production traffic first, then expand after monitoring.
